title: Skyblock and BedWars are available again
summary: Skyblock reconnects now resume safely and BedWars arenas are open again after a deployment configuration issue.
body:
- Players returning from Skyblock can resume their island normally with their saved inventory and progression.
- BedWars is available again from the lobby, with its active and standby arenas restored.
- The safety lock that protected Skyblock inventories during the interruption worked as intended; no progression or inventory reset was required.
- The deployment configuration has been corrected at its source so these game services remain enabled during future reconciliations.

Java: play.cookie-build.com
Bedrock: play.cookie-build.com, port 19132
